label: Example Analysis
description: The Jupyter notebooks contained in this notebook viewer pull data from various sources to generate and output useful tables, charts, graphs, and models. Each notebook is static, meaning the data being used by the notebooks is not updated in real time. Executable versions of these notebooks are also available in the 'Tutorials' Gen3 Workspace Image.

tools.title: Multi-Container Nextflow Tutorial
tools.description: In this notebook, we will set up and explain each file in a Nextflow workflow which uses Python scripts. Our workflow consists of two Python scripts that are each executed in a different Conda environment.

tools.title: Nextflow Proteome Data Commons (PDC) Clustergram
tools.description: In this notebook, we demonstrate how to retrieve, process, and visualize protein relative expression data from the PDC API with Nextflow. We illustrate use of Nextflow features such as channels, parameters, and environment and configuration files

tools.title: JCOIN MOUD Accessibility Analysis
tools.description: In this Jupyter notebook, we used the data from the OEPS database to analyze the Medication for Opioid Use Disorder (MOUD) providers accessibility at state and county level across the United States.

tools.title: Graphing the Pandemic Era: Unraveling Opioid Treatment Policy Shifts Amidst COVID-19
tools.description: In this notebook we use data from NIDA-PDAPS, hosted on the JCOIN Data Commons, to visualize three pandemic-era changes in opioid treatment policy at state levels across the US.

tools.title: Proteome Data Commons (PDC) Clustergram
tools.description: This notebook attempts to demonstrate the use the PDC API to retrieve the associated clinical metadata for all samples, format the data for analysis using pandas and cluster and visualize the data using the Seaborn clustermap package.

tools.title: MIDRC CT Scan
tools.description: In this notebook we demonstrate how to pull in MIDRC CT scan data, how to view the CT scan images, how to convert the image file format, and how to extract clinical data and file metadata from the DICOM file headers.

tools.title: Data Exploration using Python of Framingham Heart Study Teaching Dataset
tools.description: In this Python tutorial, we demonstrate how to pull the Framingham teaching dataset from the BioData Catalyst data commons into a BRH workspace, and perform data exploration and visualization using Python packages.

tools.title: Data Exploration using R of Framingham Heart Study Teaching Dataset
tools.description: In this tutorial, using R code, we will demonstrate how to pull the object file of the Framingham teaching dataset from the BioData Catalyst data commons into a BRH workspace and perform data exploration and visualization using R packages.

tools.title: Data Exploration of CAMP Study Teaching Dataset
tools.description: In this tutorial, we demonstrate how to pull the object file of CAMP study from BioData Catalyst data commons into a BRH workspace, and perform data exploration and visualization using Python packages.

tools.title: MIDRC Open-R1 Clinical Data Analysis
tools.description: In this notebook we will visualize the distribution of subjects accross a variety demographics and their COVID-19 status in the Open-R1 dataset from The Medical Imaging and Data Resource Center.

tools.title: Identification of Potential Drug Targets of Inflammatory Bowel Disease
tools.description: This notebook demonstrates an approach to query data in EpiGraphDB to prioritize potential alternative drug targets in the same protein-protein interaction network for Inflammatory Bowel Disease

tools.title: Predictive Insights into Heart Health: Investigating the Framingham Heart Study Dataset
tools.description: In this Jupyter notebook, we'll delve into the Framingham dataset, analyzing its contents, performing exploratory data analysis, and leveraging linear and logistic regression.
